lessons.title: Choose the locale scope deliberately
lessons.outcome: Separate LANG, category overrides and LC_ALL; make one command deterministic without changing a login default.
lessons.prerequisites: Local Shell startup/quoting; Text Archive join
lessons.learn: Inspect locale/charmap; compare controlled child environments with env; demonstrate LC_ALL precedence and remove it.
lessons.challenge: Repair an inherited category override in an isolated shell; show that the parent and system default remain unchanged.
lessons.negative_case: LANG alone does not override LC_ALL; an unavailable locale is not a valid localized result.
lessons.expected_evidence: Before/child/parent locale output, statuses, byte-exact system-default snapshot, explanation of category precedence.
lessons.cleanup: Exit only the practice child shell; delete enumerated private report files.
lessons.practice: Real disposable guest; completion self-reviewed and unscored

lessons.title: Compare localized formats without corrupting data
lessons.outcome: Use prepared de_DE.UTF-8 and en_US.UTF-8 for numeric/time categories, inspect monetary locale metadata and explicit C sorting.
lessons.learn: Read locale -k decimal_point and date formats; compare actual category outputs; keep machine TSV processing explicitly C.
lessons.challenge: Choose display categories and machine-processing locale independently for a supplied small dataset.
lessons.negative_case: Do not assume a localized decimal comma is a TSV separator or that every locale orders every sample differently.
lessons.expected_evidence: Actual locale availability, category output, retained byte-level input/output and tested sorting interpretation.
lessons.cleanup: Unset child overrides; retain originals; remove only exact private outputs.
lessons.practice: Real disposable guest; completion self-reviewed and unscored

lessons.title: Convert text strictly and preserve a recovery path
lessons.outcome: Distinguish UTF-8 bytes/characters from ASCII and ISO-8859-1; detect invalid or unrepresentable input.
lessons.learn: Use tiny manually entered or octal-byte fixtures; strict iconv to a separate destination; compare expected bytes and round-trip; capture a failure and partial destination.
lessons.challenge: Identify the correct source encoding, recover an independently specified payload, and explain a rejected conversion.
lessons.negative_case: Wrong declared source can yield valid but wrong text; //IGNORE/transliteration are not permitted repairs; nonzero status may leave partial output.
lessons.expected_evidence: Input hashes, byte counts/od, status/error, independent expected bytes and successful round-trip where representable.
lessons.cleanup: Remove named conversion candidates only after source hashes match; no rewriting originals.
lessons.practice: Real disposable guest; completion self-reviewed and unscored

lessons.title: Make a guest locale default reversible
lessons.outcome: Distinguish per-command settings from a new guest login default; apply and restore one documented locale policy.
lessons.learn: Snapshot /etc/default/locale as bytes/mode/owner; use update-locale in the disposable guest; verify a new login context without changing passwords/PAM.
lessons.challenge: Correct one prepared default/category inconsistency and prove new-session versus existing-shell behavior.
lessons.negative_case: Editing LANG in the current shell is not persistent; LC_ALL can conceal the changed default.
lessons.expected_evidence: Protected before copy, exact changed fields, real fresh-session locale and successful byte/mode/owner rollback.
lessons.cleanup: Restore only the unchanged-identity snapshot through a reviewed guard; refuse unexpected policy edits; Reset if rollback cannot be established.
lessons.practice: Real disposable guest; completion self-reviewed and unscored

lessons.title: Interpret timezones without changing the clock
lessons.outcome: Distinguish UTC instants, local display and DST; configure and restore guest timezone while leaving clock/NTP controls untouched.
lessons.learn: Use fixed winter/summer UTC instants with TZ; inspect timedatectl/RTC/NTP; snapshot localtime state; set-timezone and restore the prior zone.
lessons.challenge: Resolve two ambiguous-looking log displays, choose the requested guest zone, and demonstrate fixed-instant equivalence plus live elapsed-time continuity without setting the clock.
lessons.negative_case: A zone abbreviation is not a globally unique zone; TZ/date display is not NTP synchronization or setting the system/RTC clock.
lessons.expected_evidence: Fixed-instant offsets, original/final localtime link or bytes, monotonic/epoch observations, timedatectl fields, rollback.
lessons.cleanup: Restore exact prior guest zone; unset TZ in the practice shell. Never date -s, timedatectl set-time/set-ntp/set-local-rtc or hwclock writes.
lessons.practice: Real disposable guest; completion self-reviewed and unscored

lessons.title: Inspect an xz stream and recover exact bytes
lessons.outcome: Practice xz/xzcat, bounded memory/threads, container validation versus independent content checks.
lessons.prerequisites: Text Archive streams and original preservation
lessons.learn: Create one tiny xz candidate with original retained; list/test/decompress separately; exercise a truncated copy and memory-limit refusal without large allocations.
lessons.challenge: Select and recover the correct small stream, prove independent expected bytes and retain the rejected candidate.
lessons.negative_case: xz -t success is not authenticity or the correct report; avoid default source deletion and force overwrite.
lessons.expected_evidence: Source hash, compressed/list/check status, bounded resource options, rejected-copy evidence, restored-byte comparison.
lessons.cleanup: One worker; <=64 KiB inputs and <=256 KiB cumulative outputs, 10s/1s grace, 64 MiB xz memory cap; exact named cleanup, no arbitrary archives.
lessons.practice: Real disposable guest; completion self-reviewed and unscored

lessons.title: Inspect and cancel the exact one-off job
lessons.outcome: Distinguish queued work from completion; dynamically identify and remove only the owned practice job.
lessons.learn: Queue a harmless file-producing job with at -M at a short future time; capture actual ID/UID, inspect at -c, cancel, prove no result and unrelated jobs unchanged.
lessons.challenge: Cancel a stale practice job using retained identity evidence; leave another declared job intact.
lessons.negative_case: Never fixed job numbers, atrm all, global spool edits or count-only proof; root atq sees others.
lessons.expected_evidence: Queue ID/owner/time/body hash before/after, absence of cancelled output after its deadline, foreign job preserved.
lessons.cleanup: Remove only positively matched owned jobs; do not delete workspace while a matching queued/running job can still write.
lessons.practice: Real disposable guest; completion self-reviewed and unscored

lessons.title: Prove a one-off job’s environment and result
lessons.outcome: Observe /bin/sh execution, captured environment/cwd/umask and actual successful or failed result.
lessons.learn: Queue one finite script using absolute paths, at -M and explicit output/status recording; compare captured values with later interactive changes.
lessons.challenge: Repair an environment/path error, retain the first failure, and prove expected UID/content/status of a distinct retry.
lessons.negative_case: Queue disappearance is not successful completion; shell functions/Bash syntax are not automatically a /bin/sh environment; no promised mail.
lessons.expected_evidence: Actual job UID/cwd/umask, exact bytes/status, failed job retained, 6s child timeout and <=150s observation deadline.
lessons.cleanup: Wait for verified child exit, cancel exact pending retry if interrupted, remove exact files; do not claim disk Resume preserves processes.
lessons.practice: Real disposable guest; completion self-reviewed and unscored

lessons.title: Test scheduler access as the intended identity
lessons.outcome: Explain allow-file precedence, deny-file fallback and separate PAM/account restrictions.
lessons.prerequisites: Existing Users/Groups access and at execution
lessons.learn: Use two named locked-password practice accounts via guest sudo/runuser; snapshot policies; apply one bounded at.allow/deny fixture and demonstrate actual admission/denial.
lessons.challenge: Repair an overbroad scheduler list without changing learner/sudo/PAM or another account; verify both identities.
lessons.negative_case: Root bypass is not ordinary-user permission; policy admission does not prove PAM/account execution success; never enable passwords to make a test pass.
lessons.expected_evidence: Exact policy bytes/modes/owner, queue/run denial and successful UID evidence, unaffected learner/auth/sudo fingerprints.
lessons.cleanup: Restore exact saved at policies; remove only owned jobs and then exact disposable accounts/homes; refuse changed snapshots.
lessons.practice: Real disposable guest; completion self-reviewed and unscored

lessons.title: Deliver a localized offline job handover
lessons.outcome: Transfer locale, encoding, time and one-off execution decisions without repeating a guided repair.
objective_subtopics: 107.3 and108.2 independent transfer; no new objective credit
lessons.learn: Trace one wrong locale/time assumption and partial output in a tiny supplied incident; retain before evidence, demonstrate corrected report and write uncertainty.
lessons.challenge: Independently deliver exact factual results from a different dataset, a successful bounded job and a readable handover.
lessons.negative_case: No causal or language-quality score from keywords; correct-looking display alone does not prove correct encoded bytes or execution.
lessons.expected_evidence: Facts, units/zone/encoding, job identity/status, original preservation, rejected hypothesis and self-review answers.
lessons.cleanup: Exact jobs/policy rollback first, then named report files; completion remains self-reviewed.
lessons.practice: Real disposable guest; completion self-reviewed and unscored

lessons.title: Identify RPM package state and file providers
lessons.outcome: Query installed NEVRA, architecture, ownership and package/source/license fields; distinguish RPM from its dependency frontend.
lessons.learn: Read rpm -q/-qi/-ql/-qf on known installed paths; inspect dnf/yum implementation/version; compare Debian terms.
lessons.challenge: Find the provider of a declared installed file and justify the exact installed release, without repository access.
lessons.negative_case: Missing package differs from unowned file; DNF-compatible yum does not demonstrate legacy YUM; Zypper is absent.
lessons.expected_evidence: Actual tool versions, NEVRA, file ownership/provider and metadata; unrelated package list unchanged.
lessons.cleanup: Read-only system queries; remove only private evidence reports.
lessons.practice: Real disposable guest; completion self-reviewed and unscored

lessons.title: Inspect an offline RPM before admitting it
lessons.outcome: Compare archive metadata/payload/digests, vendor signature trust and independent fixture expectations.
lessons.learn: Inspect two project package names/three revisions; list bounded regular payloads, configuration flags, requirements, notices and signature status; one known official signed RPM can be inspected without installing.
lessons.challenge: Reject an altered or unexpected candidate and explain exactly what trusted signature versus digest evidence establishes.
lessons.negative_case: Unsigned local fixture is not authenticated; rpm digest verification is not publisher trust; no scripts, links or unsafe extraction.
lessons.expected_evidence: Inspected payload paths/modes/owners, absence of scripts/triggers/services/accounts/privileged bits, hashes and signature result.
lessons.cleanup: Retain bad candidate; extraction only to a guarded fresh private directory; exact members, no parent/link escapes.
lessons.practice: Real disposable guest; completion self-reviewed and unscored

lessons.title: Observe a dependency failure without forcing installation
lessons.outcome: Demonstrate strict local rpm dependency checking and leave unrelated state intact.
lessons.learn: Use report package requiring exact data2.0; show rpm --test then actual refused install with matching root/configuration; no force/nodeps.
lessons.challenge: Diagnose the unavailable requirement and preserve the refused candidate; do not substitute an arbitrary version.
lessons.negative_case: --nodeps hides the issue; matching a name is not matching required version/architecture.
lessons.expected_evidence: Solver/transaction errors, unchanged full unrelated RPM inventory and fixture state, exact required version.
lessons.cleanup: No failed-state repair outside two fixture identities; remove only private reports.
lessons.practice: Real disposable guest; completion self-reviewed and unscored

lessons.title: Resolve the offline fixture dependency explicitly
lessons.outcome: Install only the two approved fixture identities using explicit local files and a checked DNF plan.
objective_subtopics: 102.5 DNF awareness/dependency frontend; modern YUM compatibility limitation
lessons.prerequisites: RPM dependency failure; guest root policy
lessons.learn: Preview under same sudo/root/configuration; exact transaction allowlist; install data2.0+report1.0 without enabled repos, weak deps or automatic removals.
lessons.challenge: Reject an unexpected plan, then produce the permitted transaction and prove installed result and account state.
lessons.negative_case: No-download/repo disabling alone is not a boundary; unprivileged preview need not match privileged execution.
lessons.expected_evidence: Exact versions/actions, plan refusal, execution status, expected files and before/after all nonfixture packages and policy.
lessons.cleanup: Remove report then data only through equivalent checked plan; never autoremove, upgrade-all or arbitrary dnf history undo.
lessons.practice: Real disposable guest; completion self-reviewed and unscored

lessons.title: Retain edited configuration during an RPM upgrade
lessons.outcome: Practice %config(noreplace), installed version and actual .rpmnew/.rpmsave behavior.
lessons.learn: Install data1.0; edit only declared conffile, upgrade data2.0 and inspect packaged/new/user bytes; record actual RPM behavior before writing guidance.
lessons.challenge: Upgrade while preserving an independently given local setting and retaining replacement evidence.
lessons.negative_case: Do not assume Debian conffile semantics or silently overwrite user content; skipped/different-version transactions are not upgrades.
lessons.expected_evidence: Versions, original/config/new candidate hashes, owners/modes and expected package-owned contents.
lessons.cleanup: Retain config candidates; checked exact-package cleanup refuses additional names/types; no broad /etc deletion.
lessons.practice: Real disposable guest; completion self-reviewed and unscored

lessons.title: Repair package-owned contents with independent verification
lessons.outcome: Distinguish rpm -V flags, package-owned digest state and expected application output; reinstall exact local archive.
lessons.learn: Change one approved regular payload, capture real verification flags, reinstall same exact package using checked plan, then inspect expected bytes/access.
lessons.challenge: Repair damage rather than hide verification output; preserve independent reference and unrelated configuration.
lessons.negative_case: Listing files or a successful reinstall does not prove content/access; configured files may legitimately differ and need policy.
lessons.expected_evidence: Actual rpm verification before/after, reference comparison, intended unprivileged-user read/result, unchanged other packages.
lessons.cleanup: Preserve damage report; remove exact fixtures through allowlisted plan; root can bypass practice guards.
lessons.practice: Real disposable guest; completion self-reviewed and unscored

lessons.title: Remove only intended packages and explain retained files
lessons.outcome: Distinguish rpm erase, dependency order and config retention from Debian remove/purge.
lessons.learn: Refuse removal of required data while report remains; remove in correct order; inspect retained changed configuration and separate user-created data.
lessons.challenge: Return to fixture-free package state while retaining owner data and explaining any .rpmsave.
lessons.negative_case: No universal RPM purge; --nodeps and autoremove can harm unrelated state; absence of rpm row does not mean every user file vanished.
lessons.expected_evidence: Dependency refusal, exact erased identities, retained configuration/content and byte-identical nonfixture inventory.
lessons.cleanup: Only explicit inspected retained fixture files after independent preservation checks; source archives remain protected.
lessons.practice: Real disposable guest; completion self-reviewed and unscored

lessons.title: Repair an offline package incident and hand it over
lessons.outcome: Independently select a compatible fixture version, restore verified content/config and leave unrelated packages untouched.
objective_subtopics: 102.5 transfer; no claim of full objective or Zypper/YUM mastery
lessons.learn: Supply partial/misleading metadata and one retained bad candidate; explain bounded recovery and expected evidence.
lessons.challenge: Independent dependency/version/config/integrity recovery, user-access proof, wrong-candidate retention and exact cleanup.
lessons.negative_case: A valid signature/digest or zero transaction status alone is insufficient; do not invent complete RPM objective coverage.
lessons.expected_evidence: All intended fixture outcomes, negative-plan refusal, exact versions/file bytes/access and unchanged unrelated package/guest policy.
lessons.cleanup: Checked fixture removal, preserved original config/archive hashes, finite output, retain failure evidence.
lessons.practice: Real disposable guest; completion self-reviewed and unscored
